tools.name: payment_preflight
tools.description: Fast pre-payment consistency guard for AI agents. Checks HTTPS destination, EVM payTo format, Base network, amount validity, and detects recipient/network/price changes against caller expectations. Returns allow/review/block. Use vendor_preflight for deep KYB.

tools.name: vendor_preflight
tools.description: Verify vendor identity before paying: KYB, supplier risk and counterparty checks for AI agents. Returns allow/review/block with legal-entity evidence, potential sanctions signals, RDAP domain evidence and company-domain consistency. Payment safety decision support via x402; not legal or transaction
